inputs.name: taskApiCost.model
inputs.description: The model id matched exactly and case-sensitively against the built-in rate table (claude-haiku-5-5, claude-opus-5-5, claude-sonnet-5-5, gpt-6-luna, gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6-astra), which supplies the token rates and the source URL. Any other string has no rate, so source is null, and without a valid reportedCostUsd the basis is 'unavailable'.

inputs.name: taskApiCost.usage
inputs.description: CLI token counters for one task (inputTokens, outputTokens, cacheReadTokens, cacheWriteTokens, cacheWriteLongTokens); a finite reportedCostUsd of zero or more is returned unchanged as usd, minimumUsd and maximumUsd with basis 'cli-reported'. Without a valid reportedCostUsd, omitted usage (default undefined), a null inputTokens or outputTokens, or contradictory cache counters (cacheReadTokens, or cacheReadTokens plus cacheWriteTokens, above inputTokens; cacheWriteLongTokens above a non-null cacheWriteTokens) give basis 'unavailable' with null amounts.

outputs.name: taskApiCost
outputs.description: The synchronous API-equivalent cost of one task at standard global rates, never a subscription invoice, with rateCard always 'standard-global-2026-10-25' and source set to the model's pricing page URL or null when the model has no rate. usd is set for a CLI-reported cost or when minimumUsd and maximumUsd agree within 1e-12, otherwise usd is null and the two bounds give the range; basis is 'cli-reported', 'standard-api-estimate' or 'unavailable', and every amount is null when unavailable.

examples.note: CLI-reported API-equivalent token cost; actual subscription charge is unknown.
Standard global token rates, excluding tools, regional and fast-tier surcharges. Ranges preserve missing cache-write duration and per-request context tiers.
No verified rates for this exact model.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown as a TypeError when model is an inherited Object.prototype name such as 'constructor', 'toString' or '__proto__' (the rates lookup has no own-property check), usage has non-null inputTokens and outputTokens, there is no valid reportedCostUsd, and the cache counters pass the consistency checks.
